[[Xuekao, the Deceptive]] is an [[Am Fah]] [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Pongmei Valley]] [[explorable area]].

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Pongmei Valley}}

== Skills ==
(20 [[Deadly Arts]] in [[Hard mode]])
* {{skill icon|Assassin's Promise}} ([[elite]])
* {{skill icon|Golden Phoenix Strike}}
* {{skill icon|Repeating Strike}}
* {{skill icon|Shadow Refuge}}
* {{skill icon|Unsuspecting Strike}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Am Fah Cape]]
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Bolt of Linen]]
* [[Daggers of Xuekao]] ([[unique]])
* [[Plague Idol]]
* [[Sapphire]]

== Notes ==
* Be careful when you approach Xuekao, as several Am Fah will [[popup|drop down]] from the ceiling including in close proximity to him. 
** If you approach from [[Maatu Keep]] you can avoid most of the [[mob]]s, primarily the Jade Brotherhood.
** The remaining Jade Brotherhood will swarm to Xuekao's location and engage the Am Fah.

== Trivia ==
* Xuekao, the Deceptive originally had the elite skill [[Way of the Empty Palm]]. In the [[Game updates/20060519|May 19, 2006 update]], his elite skill was changed to Assassin's Promise which originally couldn't be captured; however, the rest of his skill set was not changed.
